messages:
Nikhil: seeing a short 502 spike on /api/generate around 10:42 PDT, paging us. where's the quick dash + log query to grab traces? thinking we should propose alert debounce to 5m if bursty.
maria: thanks Nikhil. quick dash: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/ingress/errors?panelId=5&var-route=/api/generate
tim: for traces use our Jaeger UI filter: service=ingress, operation=/api/generate, tags: http.status_code=502. link: https://jaeger.redwood.ai/search?service=ingress&operation=/api/generate
sre-oncall: copying runbook — runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/502-gateway-timeout
observability-bot: Note: Recent deploy at ~10:30 by @olivia could be related. Deploy: build/5392
olivia: I rolled back a small config change at 10:33; will check logs. sending sample curl to reproduce
olivia: ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/api/generate" -d '{\"input\":\"test\"}'```
maria: Log search in Loki: query `{job=\"ingress\"} |= \"502\" |~ \"/api/generate\" | line_format \"{{.timestamp}} {{.level}} {{.message}}\"` — run in https://loki.redwood.ai/explore
Nikhil: any quick trace sample ids we can attach to the alert? i can paste one into the ticket.
tim: grabbed a trace: traceID=3e9f2c4b; span shows backend pool timeout at 120s. attaching link: https://jaeger.redwood.ai/trace/3e9f2c4b
sre-oncall: recommend temporarily increasing alert debounce to 6m for route=/api/generate while we investigate. I'll open a PR to the alert rules.
maria: FYI the error rate dash panels: 5xx by route, 4xx by client-ip, latency percentiles. If you want I can DM short list of panels.
olivia: confirmed rollback removed the bad header. metrics show errors dropping after 10:35.
Nikhil: ok closing loop for now. sre-oncall can you make the alert change and note in the ticket? I'll add the trace and sample logs.
sre-oncall: will do. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/observability/alerts/pulls/42. adding comment to incident ticket #INC-3492
maria: if this recurs let's open a follow-up and add evals to catch regressions. :thumbsup:
Nikhil: thanks everyone :pray:
